name: rspack-perf-kit
description: Measure Rspack builds and browser startup, trace imports, and compare optimization experiments.

scripts.demo:baseline: node example/build.mjs eager && node bin/rspack-perf-kit.mjs scan --dist example/dist --pin --coverage --feature page --label eager
scripts.demo:compare: node example/build.mjs lazy && node bin/rspack-perf-kit.mjs scan --dist example/dist --parity --coverage --feature page --label lazy && node bin/rspack-perf-kit.mjs graph-diff --dist example/dist
